title: Science Nerds and Wuxia (1)
synopsis: What does the ancient Chinese philosopher Mozi have to do with science nerds and wuxia?

fullText.simplified:
理工男与武侠（一）

    说起中国传统文化名人，很多人脑海中闪过的第一个名字大概就是孔子。事实上，在孔子所处的时代，还有一个与他齐名甚至后期影响力更大的人：墨子。他们所处的年代被称为“战国时代”，顾名思义，在当时，中国处于战争频繁的状态。
    当时的中国分裂成无数个小国，各个小国之间常年战争不断，很像同时期的古希腊。因此，在思想和文化上和同时期的古希腊也很类似，出现了大量的思想家和学派，在中国被称为“诸子百家”。其中当时最大的两个学派就是孔子创立的“儒家”和墨子创立的“墨家”，在当时有“非儒即墨”的说法。
    说起墨子和墨家，可以用两个词语来概括：理工男、武侠。这两个词语看起来似乎风马牛不相及，该如何理解呢？这就要从墨子的成长背景和核心思想说起了。
    墨子是没落贵族的后裔，最初是一个木匠，是中国历史上少有的平民出身的哲学家。由于常年战乱，底层人民生活在水深火热之中。年轻时代的墨子为了寻求解决之道，拜孔子为师。然而他并不能认同儒家学说中的部分观点，因此自立门户，创立了墨家学派，提出了“兼爱”的思想。
    墨子认为人与人之间要在平等的基础上相互友爱，频繁的战争就是因为天下人不相爱导致的。他反对战争，要求和平。在这样的思想指导下，许多社会下层人民加入了墨家，他们纷纷投入到减少战争、扶危济困的事业中去了。墨家弟子们采取的手段主要有两种：一种是通过高超的机械水平保护弱小的国家，避免百姓受苦；另一种方式则是直接帮助受苦的老百姓。
    那么，墨家弟子们是怎么通过这两种手段保卫和平的呢？我们将在下回为您讲解。
fullText.traditional:
理工男與武俠（一）

    說起中國傳統文化名人，很多人腦海中閃過的第一個名字大概就是孔子。事實上，在孔子所處的時代，還有一個與他齊名甚至後期影響力更大的人：墨子。他們所處的年代被稱為“戰國時代”，顧名思義，在當時，中國處於戰爭頻繁的狀態。
    當時的中國分裂成無數個小國，各個小國之間常年戰爭不斷，很像同時期的古希臘。因此，在思想和文化上和同時期的古希臘也很類似，出現了大量的思想家和學派，在中國被稱為“諸子百家”。其中當時最大的兩個學派就是孔子創立的“儒家”和墨子創立的“墨家”，在當時有“非儒即墨”的說法。
    說起墨子和墨家，可以用兩個詞語來概括：理工男、武俠。這兩個詞語看起來似乎風馬牛不相及，該如何理解呢？這就要從墨子的成長背景和核心思想說起了。
    墨子是沒落貴族的後裔，最初是一個木匠，是中國歷史上少有的平民出身的哲學家。由於常年戰亂，底層人民生活在水深火熱之中。年輕時代的墨子為了尋求解決之道，拜孔子為師。然而他並不能認同儒家學說中的部分觀點，因此自立門戶，創立了墨家學派，提出了“兼愛”的思想。
    墨子認為人與人之間要在平等的基礎上相互友愛，頻繁的戰爭就是因為天下人不相愛導致的。他反對戰爭，要求和平。在這樣的思想指導下，許多社會下層人民加入了墨家，他們紛紛投入到減少戰爭、扶危濟困的事業中去了。墨家弟子們採取的手段主要有兩種：一種是通過高超的機械水平保護弱小的國家，避免百姓受苦；另一種方式則是直接幫助受苦的老百姓。
    那麼，墨家弟子們是怎麼通過這兩種手段保衛和平的呢？我們將在下回為您講解。

sentences.english: At first, Mozi was a carpenter, making him one of the few Chinese philosophers with a background as a commoner.

sentences.simplified: 年轻时代的墨子为了寻求解决之道，拜孔子为师。
sentences.traditional: 年輕時代的墨子為了尋求解決之道，拜孔子為師。

sentences.pinyin: rán ér tā bìng bù néng rèn tóng rú jiā xué shuō zhōng de bù fen guān diǎn
sentences.english: The young Mozi, in order to find a solution for this, decided to follow Confucius as his teacher.

sentences.simplified: 因此自立门户，创立了墨家学派，提出了“兼爱”的思想。
sentences.traditional: 因此自立門戶，創立了墨家學派，提出了“兼愛”的思想。
sentences.pinyin: yīn cǐ zì lì mén hù chuàng lì le mò jiā xué pài tí chū le jiān ài de sī xiǎng
sentences.english: However, he did not agree with some of the viewpoints of Confucianism.
So, he branched off and created his own school of thought, putting forward the idea of “universal love”.

sentences.simplified: 墨子认为人与人之间要在平等的基础上相互友爱，
sentences.traditional: 墨子認為人與人之間要在平等的基礎上相互友愛，
sentences.pinyin: mò zǐ rèn wéi rén yǔ rén zhī jiān yào zài píng děng de jī chǔ shang xiāng hù yǒu ài

sentences.simplified: 频繁的战争就是因为天下人不相爱导致的。
sentences.traditional: 頻繁的戰爭就是因為天下人不相愛導致的。
sentences.pinyin: pín fán de zhàn zhēng jiù shì yīn wèi tiān xià rén bù xiāng ài dǎo zhì de
sentences.english: Mozi believed that people should love one another on the basis of equality.

sentences.simplified: 他反对战争，要求和平。
sentences.traditional: 他反對戰爭，要求和平。
sentences.pinyin: tā fǎn duì zhàn zhēng yāo qiú hé píng
sentences.english: He believed that the frequent wars were precisely because people did not show love towards one another.

sentences.simplified: 在这样的思想指导下，许多社会下层人民加入了墨家，
sentences.traditional: 在這樣的思想指導下，許多社會下層人民加入了墨家，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè yàng de sī xiǎng zhǐ dǎo xià xǔ duō shè huì xià céng rén mín jiā rù le mò jiā
sentences.english: He opposed war and demanded peace.

sentences.simplified: 他们纷纷投入到减少战争、扶危济困的事业中去了。
sentences.traditional: 他們紛紛投入到減少戰爭、扶危濟困的事業中去了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men fēn fēn tóu rù dào jiǎn shǎo zhàn zhēng fú wēi jì kùn de shì yè zhōng qù le
sentences.english: Under the direction of this philosophy, many people of a lower social status joined the school of Mohism.

sentences.simplified: 墨家弟子们采取的手段主要有两种：
sentences.traditional: 墨家弟子們採取的手段主要有兩種：
sentences.pinyin: mò jiā dì zǐ men cǎi qǔ de shǒu duàn zhǔ yào yǒu liǎng zhǒng
sentences.english: One by one, they invested themselves an undertaking that worked to reduce war and help those in need.

sentences.simplified: 一种是通过高超的机械水平保护弱小的国家，避免百姓受苦；
sentences.traditional: 一種是通過高超的機械水平保護弱小的國家，避免百姓受苦；
sentences.pinyin: yì zhǒng shì tōng guò gāo chāo de jī xiè shuǐ píng bǎo hù ruò xiǎo de guó jiā bì miǎn bǎi xìng shòu kǔ
sentences.english: The followers of Mohism largely adopted two measures.

sentences.simplified: 另一种方式则是直接帮助受苦的老百姓。
sentences.traditional: 另一種方式則是直接幫助受苦的老百姓。
sentences.pinyin: lìng yì zhǒng fāng shì zé shì zhí jiē bāng zhù shòu kǔ de lǎo bǎi xìng
sentences.english: One was to protect weak states through highly advanced machinery, helping to prevent suffering among the common people.
The other measure was to directly help the common people who were suffering.

sentences.simplified: 那么，墨家弟子们是怎么通过这两种手段保卫和平的呢？我们将在下回为您讲解。
sentences.traditional: 那麼，墨家弟子們是怎麼通過這兩種手段保衛和平的呢？我們將在下回為您講解。
sentences.pinyin: nà me mò jiā dì zǐ men shì zěn me tōng guò zhè liǎng zhǒng shǒu duàn bǎo wèi hé píng de ne wǒ men jiāng zài xià huí wèi nín jiǎng jiě

sentences.english: How exactly did the followers of Mohism use these two measures to preserve peace? We’ll explain this to you next time.

raw.synopsis: What does the ancient Chinese philosopher Mozi have to do with science nerds and wuxia?
sentence_translations: Science Nerds and Wuxia (1)
When speaking of famous traditional Chinese scholars, ..
.. for many people, the first name that comes to mind is probably Confucius.
In reality, during Confucius’ era there was someone else of equal importance, ..
.. someone who perhaps had an even greater influence on later generations: Mozi.
The era they were from is called the “Warring States Period”.
As the name suggests, during that time, China was in a state of frequent wars.
At the time, China was split into countless small states.
The small states would constantly be at war with each other, similar to Ancient Greece at the time.
Therefore, the thought and culture were also quite similar to Ancient Greece at the time, ..
.. with numerous thinkers and schools of thought appearing.
In China, this was called “The Hundred Schools of Thought”.
Of these, the two biggest schools of thought were “Confucianism”, established by Confucius, and “Mohism”, established by Mozi.
At the time, there was the saying ”if it’s not Confucianism, then it must be Mohism”.
We can summarize Mozi and Mohism in two terms: science nerds and wuxia.
These two phrases seem to be completely unrelated to one another. So, how can we interpret this?
We need to start with Mozi’s upbringing and his core thinking.
Mozi was a descendant of a declining noble family.
At first, Mozi was a carpenter, making him one of the few Chinese philosophers with a background as a commoner.
Because of the constant state of war, life for people at the bottom of the social hierarchy was full of suffering.
The young Mozi, in order to find a solution for this, decided to follow Confucius as his teacher.
However, he did not agree with some of the viewpoints of Confucianism.
So, he branched off and created his own school of thought, putting forward the idea of “universal love”.
Mozi believed that people should love one another on the basis of equality.
He believed that the frequent wars were precisely because people did not show love towards one another.
He opposed war and demanded peace.
Under the direction of this philosophy, many people of a lower social status joined the school of Mohism.
One by one, they invested themselves an undertaking that worked to reduce war and help those in need.
The followers of Mohism largely adopted two measures.
One was to protect weak states through highly advanced machinery, helping to prevent suffering among the common people.
The other measure was to directly help the common people who were suffering.
How exactly did the followers of Mohism use these two measures to preserve peace? We’ll explain this to you next time.
